method: One-off copy of workspace_window with headless framebuffer and serial submit/wait. Alternates file-list scroll +/-10 logical units. Timings measure per-frame stages; AX update builds TreeUpdate but does not publish a native adapter. Desktop interactive, no affinity or isolated load. No builds/tests run concurrently with retained final CSV runs.
artifact_note: offscreen.rs is the measured fixture with only formatting and the machine-specific font path replaced by a SOURCE_FONT_PATH placeholder; reproduce.py substitutes the bundled font. Native traces use temporary instrumentation, excluded from product sources. Baseline and debug candidates used local Astrelis checkout at the pinned revision; only runner tracing was changed, unused by the headless fixture. Final release candidate reproduction uses the canonical Git dependency.
native_probe: Computer use on normal, non-topmost background window. Two scroll calls, one per pane, before and after parent-relative transforms. Before trace already includes paint culling. Timing samples are diagnostic, not representative native frame-latency percentiles.
